products.product_id: Unique product identifier (primary key); string format PXXX
products.product_name: Human-readable product name; used for display and product recognition
products.category: Product classification category for segmentation and analysis
products.standard_price: Canonical list price for the product; baseline for comparison with transactional unit_price

sales_data.transaction_id: Unique transaction identifier; some nulls indicate incomplete data capture; string format TXXNXXXXX or RETXXXXX
sales_data.transaction_date: Date when transaction occurred; inconsistent format (MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD); requires normalization
sales_data.store_id: Location identifier for physical store or channel where sale occurred; some nulls indicate missing location context
sales_data.product_id: Foreign key reference to products.product_id; enables product master lookup
sales_data.product_name: Denormalized product name from order time; may differ from current products table (captures historical name)
sales_data.category: Denormalized category from order time; inconsistent with products.category (Sport vs Sports issue)
sales_data.quantity: Number of units sold; negative values represent returns or refunds; ranges -4 to 8
sales_data.unit_price: Actual price charged per unit at transaction time; varies from standard_price due to discounts/promotions
sales_data.total_amount: Line amount (quantity × unit_price); negative values align with return transactions
sales_data.customer_segment: Customer classification at time of purchase (Loyal, Premium, etc.); 16 unique values
sales_data.payment_method: Payment instrument used (Apple Pay, PayPal, etc.); 4 distinct methods

join_keys.notes: 100% of sales_data product_id values match products primary key; no orphaned references; enables product dimension lookup
